model: Maintenance-clock planning with stated early-start limits
displacement_policy: Old as-loaded displacement limits are not applied to regenerated plans; legal ABC start windows and the configured D allowance are enforced.
objective: Priority simulated-annealing availability score from savn_priority_sa: maximise the minimum, then minimise the standard deviation, then maximise the mean. D checks are rebuilt from maintenance clocks, and each D may move inside its own early window.
limitations: No hangar/crew/parts capacity or monetary cost model. Full-horizon outcomes and terminal due clocks are reported; compare different horizons separately.
